# David Warr

David Warr is the current Deputy of [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

David Warr has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-warr#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 6 with 35% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/david-warr/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2BlGFNOuBcQ)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0032/3144/9157/files/david-war-manifesto.pdf?v=1651677174)

David Warr has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2025/12/24/st-helier-deputy-hopes-to-step-into-departing-constables-shoes/)\]
